items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Brennan's? Brennan's, yeah. Yeah, Brennan's. He played that.

ctx.x: Might be, but this place here uses about three pieces nightly. It has a piano and a guitar and something else, but it's all soft. It's all soft music, right?
Brennan's? Brennan's, yeah. Yeah, Brennan's. He played that.

Well, you see a place like that, it requires soft music for a simple reason. There's no dancing, and people is talking, and they mostly want the music for entertainment. And if they would use brass in there, it would drown the people's voice. They'd be sitting right at the table and they couldn't hear and understand what they was talking about. So those are kind of places that always did and always will require soft music. But any hall, night club, country club, or any of them kind of places, they want real…
